description: This Java class GccMapReader processes GCC linked .map files to extract and display memory layout information, including parsing lines for memory segments and calculating total sizes.

classes.name: GccMapReader
classes.description: Main class for reading and processing GCC map files to extract memory segment information.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Inner class representing a memory record with size and name, comparable by size and name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads a file, processes its lines, sorts records, and outputs total size.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes lines from the map file to extract memory records.
